# temps_shield_entry (Resource)

A Shield rule: a verdict for clients from a network or with a TLS fingerprint (JA4). Without `project_id` it applies to the whole platform. Set exactly one of `network` and `ja4`.

Import with `<project_id?>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `projects:write`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Blocks a network for one project.
resource "temps_shield_entry" "scanner" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  network    = "198.51.100.0/24"
  verdict    = "block"
  note       = "Credential stuffing"
  expires_at = "2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}

# Logs a TLS fingerprint on every project.
resource "temps_shield_entry" "bot" {
  ja4     = "t13d1516h2_8daaf6152771_02713d6af862"
  verdict = "log"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `verdict` (String) What Shield does with matching clients. One of `allow`, `log`, `challenge`, `block`.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 time the entry stops applying.
- `ja4` (String) JA4 TLS client fingerprint.
- `network` (String) CIDR network, for example `198.51.100.0/24`.
- `note` (String) Why the entry exists.
- `project_id` (Number) Project the entry applies to; unset for a platform-wide entry.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id?>/<id>`.
- `scope` (String) `platform` or `project`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<id>, or <id> for an entry of every project
terraform import temps_shield_entry.scanner 8/14
```
